policy.statement: Only entries with status visual-source-reviewed and usableInProfile true may appear on college profiles. Candidate rows are stored separately and never imported by the runtime helper.
policy.identityGate: Both UNITID and catalog slug must match. Where a single Wikidata entity has exact P1771 equality, that entity is recorded as additional identity evidence.

presentation.alt: The twin brick towers and arched entrance of Royce Hall at UCLA beside a green lawn.
